implementation_gate: Adapt and test the old-cohort-only controller; freeze new family folds, aggregation, support controls, input/source pins and exact fit ceiling before execution.

rows.question: What exactly changed in the dataset?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare documented old/new generation, operating support, healthy construction, timing, labels and grouping; do not attribute score changes to a single difference.
rows.output_to_generate: Old/new dataset specification table with provenance.

rows.question: Are classes and folds adequately represented?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Count twelve labels overall and by family, spatial cell, fold and analysis view; distinguish multiclass and binary imbalance.
rows.output_to_generate: Count tables and class/family composition plots.

rows.question: Which load regimes are covered?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Map 27 factorial anchors plus 12 interior anchors and 117 healthy-only points in the approved 75-125% three-load box; report fixed Q/P and unchanged auxiliary load.
rows.output_to_generate: Load-coordinate table and three-dimensional/projection coverage plots.

rows.question: Is fault-location sampling comparable across regimes?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Tabulate regime x line x distance coverage, nominal oversampling and unsampled crossings. True location remains diagnostic metadata only.
rows.output_to_generate: Spatial coverage heatmap and sampling table.

rows.question: Do saved files match the declared acquisition?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Verify plan/config/source identities, schema, channel direction/order, clocks, dimensions, labels, finite values and complete returns; preserve an exclusion ledger.
rows.output_to_generate: Data integrity report and machine-readable case inventory.

rows.question: Are healthy and prefault conditions electrically settled?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Summarize actual voltage bounds, settling changes, harmonic/DC residuals, KCL, auxiliary branch and contact/snubber checks against declared tolerances.
rows.output_to_generate: Gate outcomes and numerical quality table with failures/margins.

rows.question: Is the analyzed interval free of prefix and clearing?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Check all half-open 200 ms intervals, common 50 ms offset, sample indices, command timing and complete channels.
rows.output_to_generate: Timing diagram and per-case interval audit.

rows.question: Are healthy windows genuinely different?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare exact and near-duplicate raw windows using phase-sensitive and phase-aligned distances plus amplitude/phase spread, within and across families. Distinct hashes alone are insufficient.
rows.output_to_generate: Duplicate/near-template report and representative overlays/residuals.

rows.question: Does healthy enrichment create a shortcut?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare full versus common-anchor support and quantify overlap of load/signal distributions; report extra-healthy false alarms and training-with/without-enrichment sensitivity.
rows.output_to_generate: Support-overlap plots and enrichment-control table.

rows.question: What variability and outliers are present?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Summarize channel RMS/amplitudes, moments and load-conditioned quantiles by class/family; flag rather than automatically delete extremes.
rows.output_to_generate: Descriptive statistics, distributions and outlier ledger.

rows.question: How separable and redundant are the descriptors?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Correlations, effective rank and exploratory standardized PCA for RMS/mean/std/extra descriptors; flag the algebraic RMS-mean-variance relation. Keep visualization preprocessing out of fitted classifiers.
rows.output_to_generate: Correlation/rank table and exploratory representation plots.

rows.question: What physical validity remains unestablished?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Retain static-source/constant-Z, zero-sequence, ABC/ABCG and healthy-support limits; distinguish numerical screens from certified realism. Preserve fourteen historical E16 voltage failures.
rows.output_to_generate: Validity and exclusions table, with retained negative evidence.

rows.question: Is train/test leakage prevented?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Validate family-disjoint five-fold assignment, case hashes and derived-corruption membership; require every declared class in train/test.
rows.output_to_generate: Frozen fold manifest and leakage audit.

rows.question: What population does a reported score describe?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Predeclare pooled versus family/class-standardized weighting and shared-support/extra-healthy populations; compute each separately.
rows.output_to_generate: Estimand and sample-weight specification table.

rows.question: Are transformations and choices learned only from training data?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Trace scaling, optional feature selection, model calibration and any tuning to training/inner partitions only. Test labels may not choose filters/weights/settings.
rows.output_to_generate: Processing diagram and leakage-safe estimator audit.

rows.question: Are clean references meaningful?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Evaluate train-prior and majority-label dummies plus fixed simple learned models using the same outer folds. Do not average class labels.
rows.output_to_generate: Baseline performance and class-wise prediction table.

rows.question: Is the comparison intrinsic robustness or noisy adaptation?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Separately evaluate clean-trained/noisy-tested deployment and matched-condition training/testing; keep cases and folds identical.
rows.output_to_generate: Two-protocol definition and side-by-side results.

rows.question: Are comparisons paired and reproducible?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Freeze seeds, corruption identities, fold/class order, fixed configurations and contrast IDs; retain predictions for the same held-out cases.
rows.output_to_generate: Frozen run matrix, comparison registry and hashes.

rows.question: Are exclusions visible and fairly applied?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Record convergence warnings, fit exceptions, degenerate features and missing classes; no silent retries or favorable replacement settings.
rows.output_to_generate: Fit/warning/exclusion ledger and eligible-comparison counts.

rows.question: Are probabilities valid for fusion?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Check finite nonnegative probabilities, class alignment, unit sums and calibration behavior; distinguish probability argmax from a model's native decision.
rows.output_to_generate: Probability validation and calibration/Brier or log-loss summary.

rows.question: Are aggregate results hiding dependence on one regime?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Report per-family and per-spatial-cell errors, nominal versus nonnominal sensitivity and predeclared aggregation weights. No unseen-location claim from regime holdout alone.
rows.output_to_generate: Regime/location breakdown and sensitivity table.

rows.question: Is the twelve-class decision distinguishable from detection?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Preserve twelve-class metrics and separately derive noFault false alarms, missed faults and phase/ground confusions. Explain ABC/ABCG ambiguity without silently merging labels.
rows.output_to_generate: Class hierarchy/error decomposition table.

rows.question: What is each classifier actually given?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Define RMS6, RAW12 mean/std and MULTI18, units, order and formulas; no time-order information claim for means/std.
rows.output_to_generate: Feature dictionary and representation-size table.

rows.question: Which representation works on clean data?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare all three base views under the same classifier/scaler/folds, including both individual constituents.
rows.output_to_generate: Clean score grid with per-class outcomes.

rows.question: Which representation degrades under noise?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare base views at every declared noise/SNR/filter/protocol, without selecting a different winner per cell as a deployment rule.
rows.output_to_generate: Representation robustness curves and paired differences.

rows.question: Does skewness itself help?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Add skewness alone to each applicable base view and compare against exactly that base on a frozen bounded subgrid.
rows.output_to_generate: Skewness-only ablation, feature dimensions and uncertainty.

rows.question: Does a larger higher-order feature bundle help?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare skewness/kurtosis/crest bundle against both the base and skewness-only control; preserve harms and constant-channel rules.
rows.output_to_generate: Bundle ablation and numerical-stability table.

rows.question: Does gain come from I/V complementarity?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Run a bounded matched I-only, V-only and I+V ablation for declared representative models/conditions; distinguish sensing-channel fusion from descriptor fusion.
rows.output_to_generate: Current/voltage ablation with paired effects.

rows.question: What disturbances were injected?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Specify AWGN, drift, impulsive, gain-plus-AWGN and mixed equations, seeds, rates, bandwidths and mixture weights; no CT-saturation or field-representativeness equivalence.
rows.output_to_generate: Noise configuration table and example waveforms.

rows.question: Were SNR and offsets actually achieved?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Recompute measured per-window/channel additive SNR, total error SNR, relative mean bias, noise RMS and gain diagnostics with floating-point tolerances.
rows.output_to_generate: Noise diagnostics table with distributions/tolerance failures.

rows.question: Are all branches exposed to the same disturbance?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Verify that filters, representations and fusion constituents share the exact noisy source; no clean RMS paired with corrupted RAW.
rows.output_to_generate: Shared-exposure identity audit and processing diagram.

rows.question: How does performance vary with SNR?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Plot each protocol against 10/20/40/60/120 dB, with independent clean references; separate noise types and identify every displayed configuration.
rows.output_to_generate: Macro-F1/BA/MCC and contextual accuracy/weighted-F1 curves.

rows.question: What is the degradation from actual clean?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Report signed absolute score loss in percentage points; normalized loss only with explicit nonzero denominator. Preserve negative losses/improvements.
rows.output_to_generate: Degradation tables and signed-drop plots.

rows.question: Where are transitions or plateaus?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Describe observed changes across the fixed grid and uncertainty; no universal knee or test-set-driven tuning. Any later refinement is exploratory and separately bounded.
rows.output_to_generate: Local SNR increment table and transition discussion.

rows.question: Does the conclusion depend on one noise realization?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Freeze a bounded repeat-noise sensitivity slice before scores; share repeats across competing methods and retain family dependence. Repeats are not new independent cases.
rows.output_to_generate: Repeat-noise variability and conclusion-stability table.

rows.question: What do the filters do and cost?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Document none, SG, median and soft/hard wavelet settings, edge behavior and clean-signal distortion.
rows.output_to_generate: Filter/settings table and clean/noisy/processed overlays.

rows.question: Does denoising help classification?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare each filter with none for the same corruption, representation, classifier, training protocol and held-out cases.
rows.output_to_generate: Paired denoiser gains/losses and heatmaps.

rows.question: Does denoising also damage clean classification?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Evaluate every filter on uncorrupted data, not just noisy signals; include waveform and score changes.
rows.output_to_generate: Clean-cost versus noisy-benefit table.

rows.question: Which classes benefit or suffer?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Decompose each declared denoiser contrast by label/family, especially healthy false alarms and ABC/ABCG confusions.
rows.output_to_generate: Per-class filter effects and confusion-difference matrices.

rows.question: What does the energy ratio actually measure?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compute unclipped processed/noisy HF energy and clean-reference ratios, noise inflation and reconstruction error; flag near-zero denominators.
rows.output_to_generate: Corrected TPI/energy definitions, distributions and artifact table.

rows.question: Is the energy conclusion operator-dependent?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare the declared db4 D3 primary operator with D1 and FFT-band sensitivities, including I/V/channel differences.
rows.output_to_generate: Operator/reference sensitivity table and energy panels.

rows.question: Does retained HF energy predict useful classification?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Examine predeclared/exploratory TPI-score and TPI-drop associations, stratifying noise/SNR where possible; account for shared-condition confounding.
rows.output_to_generate: Labeled association plots and sensitivity results, not a causal denoiser-selection rule.

rows.question: Which learners and settings were tested?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: List eight classifiers, hyperparameters, seeds, stopping criteria and probability settings; distinguish MLP descriptors from sequential DL.
rows.output_to_generate: Model/configuration table.

rows.question: How do classifiers perform on clean data?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare every base representation without test-driven best-view selection; report primary and secondary metrics with uncertainty.
rows.output_to_generate: Eight-model clean benchmark table and class-wise supplement.

rows.question: How does the classifier interact with noise and filtering?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Evaluate the fixed robustness matrix for both protocols and retain all conditional rankings.
rows.output_to_generate: Classifier x noise x filter score/effect heatmaps.

rows.question: Which scaling choices help or harm?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare None, Standard, MinMax, Robust, Yeo-Johnson and Quantile-normal using train-only fitting and unchanged learner/folds.
rows.output_to_generate: Scaling response table and classifier/representation interaction plots.

rows.question: Do clean scaling conclusions survive noisy exposure?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Run a predeclared noisy scaling sensitivity slice rather than assume clean rankings generalize; compare against both none and the fixed default.
rows.output_to_generate: Clean-versus-noisy scaler effect table.

rows.question: Are ranking and reported gains numerically reliable?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Retain nonconvergence, zero-variance/constant-channel issues and prediction collapse diagnostics; separate eligible and excluded results.
rows.output_to_generate: Numerical health and label-prediction distribution report.

rows.question: What is the performance-cost trade-off?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Report comparable per-fit and per-window prediction costs, processing costs and model size on identified hosts; no equal-budget or real-time claim from total runtimes.
rows.output_to_generate: Cost-performance scatter/Pareto table.

rows.question: Does concatenation beat either constituent?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare MULTI18 separately against RAW12 and RMS6 under identical training/evaluation choices.
rows.output_to_generate: Two constituent-referenced early-fusion effect tables/plots.

rows.question: Does simple late fusion help?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Average aligned constituent probabilities with a fixed 0.5/0.5 rule; compare with each constituent and early fusion.
rows.output_to_generate: Late-fusion performance and paired contrast table.

rows.question: Are the constituent errors complementary?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Quantify disagreement, joint errors, one-correct/other-wrong cases and probability behavior by class/noise; distinguish complementarity from feature independence.
rows.output_to_generate: Error-complementarity matrix and class-wise table.

rows.question: Is fusion gain robust across conditions?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare early/late effects across noise, SNR, denoiser, learner and both protocols, preserving failures and uncertainty.
rows.output_to_generate: Fusion-gain curves/heatmaps and win/harm/inconclusive counts.

rows.question: Does true-SNR weighting provide only oracle evidence?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: If retained for original-paper continuity, label weights using injected true SNR as ORACLE and compare with fixed averaging. No unknown-SNR deployment claim.
rows.output_to_generate: Separate oracle-only sensitivity table.

rows.question: Can a claimed gain be explained by capacity or scaling?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Keep constituent scaler/model settings explicit, include simple concatenation/default controls and account for feature dependence; do not equate more columns with new information.
rows.output_to_generate: Fusion interpretation and control checklist.

rows.question: When should fusion not be recommended?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Report material harms, ties, uncertainty and extra cost; state conditional decision boundaries supported by evaluated cases.
rows.output_to_generate: Qualified fusion recommendation table, not universal superiority wording.

rows.question: Which metrics answer the question?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Macro-F1, balanced accuracy and MCC; contextual accuracy/weighted F1, per-class precision/recall/F1, healthy false alarms and missed faults.
rows.output_to_generate: Complete metric dictionary and long-form numerical results.

rows.question: How uncertain is each key estimate?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Family-cluster intervals with the declared weighting and full-class support; pooled OOF estimates are not means of independent folds.
rows.output_to_generate: Confidence intervals and uncertainty plots for prespecified panels.

rows.question: Are method differences supported?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Pair cases for filter-vs-none, fusion-vs-both-constituents, scaler-vs-reference and descriptor ablations; bootstrap/permutation must respect family grouping.
rows.output_to_generate: Effect estimates in percentage points, intervals and paired-test outputs.

rows.question: Are many comparisons inflating conclusions?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Predeclare contrast families, primary slice and Holm or another justified correction; keep excluded comparisons visible and distinguish exploratory findings.
rows.output_to_generate: Raw/adjusted p-values, family sizes and inference eligibility.

rows.question: Are effects useful rather than merely detectable?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Report signed effect magnitude and uncertainty; define any materiality threshold before outcomes or avoid a binary practical-significance claim.
rows.output_to_generate: Benefit/harm/inconclusive summary with an explicit rule.

rows.question: Which interactions change the answer?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Analyze paired processing x representation/fusion x noise/SNR contrasts, conditioning on classifier/protocol. Do not run ordinary ANOVA on dependent grid cells/five folds as IID samples.
rows.output_to_generate: Interaction contrast/heatmap table and scoped conclusions.

rows.question: Do weighting and healthy enrichment change the conclusions?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare pooled versus standardized estimates and full versus common support/training controls; report extra-healthy-only errors separately.
rows.output_to_generate: Aggregation/enrichment sensitivity forest plot/table.

rows.question: What is negative, ambiguous or not tested?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Retain numerical failures, harms, ties, unidentifiable taxonomy distinctions and gaps; no absent significance equals equivalence without an equivalence design.
rows.output_to_generate: Negative-results and unresolved-claims register.

rows.question: What processing/evaluation was actually executed?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Connect acquisition, window, corruption, filter, descriptors, train-only scaling, learning, fusion, evaluation and inference; separate the two training protocols.
rows.output_to_generate: Updated workflow/architecture diagram.

rows.question: Where are the classification errors?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Keep counts and row-normalized matrices for all declared evaluated cells; readable main panels for prespecified clean, severe-noise and paired fusion/filter cases, not only winners.
rows.output_to_generate: Confusion-matrix atlas and selected paper panels.

rows.question: What is the overall robustness profile?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Use fixed comparable configurations and five noise axes, preferably severe-noise Macro-F1 on a common 0-1 scale. Keep clean reference alongside; never clip signed drops into favorable radar polygons.
rows.output_to_generate: Radar atlas and a small representative main-paper composite.

rows.question: What does the complete experimental grid show?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Produce tidy source arrays/tables and clearly separated score, signed-effect and exclusion heatmaps; keep axes and scales consistent.
rows.output_to_generate: Full results atlas with class/filter/model/representation slices.

rows.question: How does variability appear without pseudoreplication?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Show family-level errors, clustered uncertainty and explicitly labeled distributions across configurations; do not present grid variation as replicate confidence.
rows.output_to_generate: Family error plots, interval plots and qualified descriptive boxplots.

rows.question: How much work did each PC perform?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Record assigned/completed units and fit counts, host/environment, preprocessing/fit/prediction/transfer/aggregation times, CPU/thread settings, storage and failures.
rows.output_to_generate: Per-host progress/timing ledger and execution summary.

rows.question: What efficiency gain is actually measured?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare only matched operations on identified hosts; distinguish summed fit time, campaign wall time and an unavailable comparable serial baseline. No invented speedup.
rows.output_to_generate: Timing/cost table with speedup reported only if identifiable.

rows.question: Can every reported value and image be reconstructed?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Bind scores, OOF predictions/probabilities, models, configuration/fold/input hashes and figure source values; verify numbers, class order, captions, colors, panel labels and publication-size legibility.
rows.output_to_generate: Reproducible result/figure manifest and QA report; vector and preview assets.

rows.question: Are the original paper's elements accounted for?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Map all eleven original tables and twenty-four figures to retain/update/replace/merge/remove, with reasons and new source identities. Do not reproduce unsupported sample-level scores.
rows.output_to_generate: Original-to-new asset crosswalk.

rows.question: How did old and new findings differ?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Compare compatible questions/qualitative conclusions, not scores as a controlled causal old/new improvement test; name changed data/model/split conditions.
rows.output_to_generate: Interpreted old/new claim and result comparison.

rows.question: What direct answer does each result support?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: For each question record finding, comparator, uncertainty, tested domain, alternative explanation and contradiction/reversal evidence. No guaranteed fusion/filter winner.
rows.output_to_generate: Claim-evidence-interpretation matrix.

rows.question: Which reviewer requests are supported?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Link evidence and eventual accepted text/assets to all 27 requests, especially imbalance, features, uncertainty, fusion, TPI, physics, readable figures and literature.
rows.output_to_generate: Reviewer-to-evidence-to-manuscript register.

rows.question: What may the paper conclude and where do limits belong?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: State conditional processing/fusion effects, healthy-support and model validity limits, no clearing requirement, B7-distance exclusion, offline latency and external-validity boundaries.
rows.output_to_generate: Results synthesis and Limitations evidence packet for joint writing.

rows.question: Are the final paper and replies internally consistent?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Check Methods vs actual matrix, counts, equations, tables, figure captions, bibliography, response locations and final compiled PDF. Paper completion is not campaign completion.
rows.output_to_generate: Submission consistency and unresolved-actions checklist.

rows.section: Conditional extensions that must not be silently claimed
rows.question: Is descriptor learning competitive with a temporal deep reference?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: R2-C02 requires a separate architecture/input/window/training-budget/environment decision. Use identical source families and fair timing if selected; no chosen CNN/LSTM/ResNet is implemented or authorized by this checklist alone.
rows.output_to_generate: Temporal baseline table or an explicit justified scope response.

rows.section: Conditional extensions that must not be silently claimed
rows.question: Would learned or estimated-SNR fusion improve on fixed averaging?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Define training-only weight learning or SNR estimation, inner validation and deployment inputs before evaluating. True injected SNR cannot be treated as an available input.
rows.output_to_generate: Optional adaptive-fusion comparison with fixed-fusion controls.

rows.section: Conditional extensions that must not be silently claimed
rows.question: Can aggregation be compared to a sample/sequence baseline?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: Replace the old raw-sample table only with a separately frozen matched source/window/fold comparator; do not confuse a pointwise classifier with sequence modeling.
rows.output_to_generate: Optional fair granularity/cost comparison or transparent removal of old numerical claims.

rows.section: Conditional extensions that must not be silently claimed
rows.question: Do findings transfer beyond this synthetic reduced cohort?
rows.required_analysis_and_comparator: New dense-km simulations, other grids, hardware/field data and sensor artifacts require separate data/scope authority and cannot be inferred from this campaign.
rows.output_to_generate: Future validation plan or later external-validation study.
